plan.title: The Compass: Departure
plan.scene: the compass, a tavern by the docks at night; the counter runs along one side, bottles behind it catching lamplight; a few tables scatter the floor; the sea sounds outside, waves against wood.
plan.turn: Le_pirate comes back before dawn with a letter folded in his hand; he sets it on the counter in front of justin and says: 'Read this when you're alone. Then decide if you still want to stay.'

needs.text: justin dreams of sailing his own ship one day, not being a partner's shadow
Le_pirate and Lily are both important to justin and draw him in different directions
Lily has lost someone to the sea before and fears it will take justin too

infos.text: Le_pirate and justin own the tavern together
Le_pirate has found a salvage wreck two days north and wants justin to navigate it with him at dawn
Lily works the counter most nights and is close to justin
If justin sails with Le_pirate, Le_pirate will walk out with the claim and never come back; the partnership ends; justin stays behind the counter forever
Lily's brother drowned on a salvage run five years ago; Le_pirate was on that boat and came back
Lily made her brother promise never to sail again before he died, and he broke that promise

beats.what: Le_pirate leans at the counter holding a drink, eyes on the horizon line where the lamp catches the window; Lily pours for him without looking up, her hand steady; justin arrives behind the bar and Le_pirate turns to him with his whole face alive while Lily's shoulders tighten.

Le_pirate tells justin he remembers the night they bought the tavern together, how scared they both were; Lily, still pouring, says 'You weren't scared. You laughed all night.' Le_pirate: 'That was fear, too.'

justin says to both of them, out loud: 'One day I want to captain my own ship. Not be a shadow in someone else's command. Five years I've watched men leave this bar and come back different. I want to know what they know.' Lily's hand stops moving. Le_pirate smiles.

Le_pirate sets a folded chart on the counter between his drink and justin's hands. 'I found a wreck two days north. Salvage claim, all ours. We leave at dawn.' Lily does not move. Justin asks 'Just us?' Le_pirate: 'Just us. We split it. No one else.'
Le_pirate says to justin: 'If you say no, I sail anyway. With the claim. The partnership ends. You keep the counter.' He does not look at Lily. Lily sets down her bottle and turns away.
Lily says to justin, low: 'You swore you would stay. You did swear that.' Justin: 'I never swore anything.' Lily: 'Exactly.' She turns her back and does not speak again for the rest of the night.
Le_pirate says to justin: 'Your brother was the bravest man I knew. If he were here, he would tell you: the sea doesn't take. People choose it.'

beats.tech: Menace: si tu X, je Y
beats.what: Le_pirate, hand on justin's shoulder: 'You sail with me, you sail alone. Lily won't wait for you to come back.' Lily does not turn around. Le_pirate: 'You stay here, you never leave this counter. Not with me.'
justin stands between them. Le_pirate's hand is still on his shoulder. Lily's back is turned. The sun is not yet up. What does justin do?
opts: Sail with Le_pirate at dawn. Tell Lily goodbye now, while it is dark.
Stay at the counter. Tell Le_pirate no, and watch him walk out that door.

beats.what: Le_pirate comes back before dawn with a letter folded in his hand and sets it on the counter: 'Read this when you're alone. Then decide if you still want to stay.'
Lily, at the dock in the dark, watches justin and Le_pirate load rope onto the ship without moving from the tavern step.
Le_pirate, on the ship, says to justin: 'We leave now.' At the same moment, Lily appears at the tavern door; she sees justin with rope in hand; she sits and does not look away until they cast off.
